answer: Random-beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond; a public beacon picks a random subset each epoch, and each chosen agent must answer a fresh challenge in a 30-second pulse window, proving real compute. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 live machines: a 50,000 POA canyon no fake army can cross, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards. Missed heartbeats slash the bond.
